verdict.rationale: Mintlify serves its own llms.txt, confirmed by a live HTTP 200 probe and by indexed /docs/llms.txt and /blog/llms.txt content. It also auto-generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt for hosted sites, offers per-page Markdown via .md URLs (seen live at use-cases/*.md), and adds skill.md files and a hierarchical llms.txt so agents can reach every page. The /docs.md 404 is not a contradiction, since the documented pattern is appending .md to individual page URLs. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these files, and a working root-level docs.md.
